questions.question_text:
A cone has a curved surface area of $96\pi\text{ cm}^{2}$ and a base radius of $8\text{ cm}$.
Find its slant height.

options.why: Divided by the diameter $16$ instead of the radius $8$.
Kept the $\pi$ instead of cancelling it from both sides.
Subtracted a base circle first, treating $96\pi$ as a total surface area.

questions.solution_text:
The curved surface area is $\pi rl$.
$96\pi=\pi\times8\times l$
$96=8l$
$l=12\text{ cm}$
